Title: Some admins' Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat usage reports may be delayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins' Copilot and Copilot Chat usage reports may be delayed by 24 hours in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Current status: Our service telemetry has alerted us to ongoing data population delays of approximately 24 hours for Copilot and Copilot Chat usage reports to populate in the Microsoft 365 admin center. We're isolated that a degradation in the upstream data pipeline used to populate these reports is causing impact, and we're working to remediate the degradation to restore reports as soon as possible.

Scope of impact: Some admins' Copilot and Copilot Chat usage reports may be delayed by 24 hours in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Monday, November 2, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A degradation in the upstream data pipeline used to populate Copilot and Copilot chat usage reports is causing impact.

Next update by: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 3:00 AM UTC
